digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and GET rotation
propositions: Introduce a rotation module to manage fail-open load/save of GET rotation state via .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar while dual-writing legacy inline field during rollout

Persist rotation stamps to both sidecar and legacy inline on every BindingStore.save() call including end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, and retirement paths; read chronological max(sidecar, legacy) per Jira key
Ensure interleaved old-binary and new-binary passes produce identical rotation order by dual-writing both representations and validate through mixed-version integration test

After rotation state initialization, an idempotent pass with no absent-key GETs leaves all bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD; a pass with absent-key GETs commits both rotaton file representations
Stage and commit both rotation files via explicit local binding-store commit path without git add -A; include GET_ROTATION_FILE in git_adapter constant and reconcile_helpers staging list
Update _store/push.py regenerable-files documentation to name get_rotation.json; maintain outbound_differ.py at or below 800 lines after extraction
